_comment: i18n report allowlist (api-server). files: regexes on paths relative to artifacts/api-server; literals: regexes on the literal text. Only for Russian-input parsers, seed data and fixtures, never for user-facing text. A single line can also be skipped with an `i18n-ignore` comment (same or previous line).

_reasons.^src/lib/permissionsMatrix\\.ts$: server-a: RU source of capability label/description/group. The file is imported raw by scripts/check-permissions.mjs (Node type stripping, cannot import dictionaries) and mirrored by the frontend; EN/UZ in src/i18n/{en,uz}/permissions.ts via lib/permissionsI18n.ts.
_reasons.^src/lib/academyCohortsDemo\\.ts$: server-a: demo seed for cohorts (names of local members, sample cohort/session/goal texts written as a mentor would); rows become user content.
_reasons.^src/lib/academySeedCourse\\.ts$: server-a: demo course content (seed data written into academy_* tables, staff-editable user content afterwards).
_reasons.^src/lib/propreports/__fixtures__/: server-b: PropReports parser fixtures (sample trader names and report text as PropReports sends them).
